items.title: [Scotto] Free agent forward Guerschon Yabusele has agreed to a three-year deal with Panathinaikos. Yabusele will be one of the top three highest-paid European players. He's averaged 8.3 points over the past two NBA seasons with the 76ers, Bulls and Knicks.
